guide.title: How to set up OBS
guide.step1: Use OBS Studio 30 or newer and open Settings, then Stream.
guide.step3: Server: paste the server URL of the template you want ("Copy server URL" on its card). Each template has its own.
guide.step4: Bearer Token: paste your stream secret from the top of this page. It is the same for every template.
guide.step5: Click "Start Streaming" in OBS and you are live on 3Speak with that template. "Stop Streaming" ends the stream.
guide.encoder: Encoder: x264 or your hardware encoder
guide.bframes: No B-frames (set them to 0 if your encoder offers it)
guide.limitsFree: Free streams end after 1 hour and show a 3Speak watermark. With 3Speak Pro you can stream for 4 hours without a watermark.
guide.limitsPro: With 3Speak Pro your streams can run for 4 hours and carry no watermark.
